body:
So I tested it and even the simple class construct does not works when compiled, because it uses Object.defineProperty.

We can either:

1. drop every ES2015 line and do it the old way
2. embrace ES2015, ask our users to include es5-shim if they plan to use instantsearch.js in legacy browsers

I would go for 2 because we do not want to wake up the 1st january of 2016 and think "GOD I did no write a single ES2015 line in 2015..".

The helper and search client are already IE8+ compatible. Which mean that if you really really want to support IE8 because you are a big company then you can just roll everything yourself or include es5-shim.

I already asked once a user to include es5-shim and sham and it worked flawlessly (when the helper was not IE8 compatible)

What do you think?
